    • withWaitTimeSeconds

      public AwsSubscription.Builder withWaitTimeSeconds(long waitTimeSeconds)
      Sets the SQS long-poll wait for receives. An empty receive is held open for the full wait, so a RetryConfig attemptTimeout or totalTimeout that does not exceed it aborts every empty receive. When unset, the queue's ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds applies.
